cc:Work.dc:title: Box - RegularBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with regular polygon as base
For short side walls that don't fit a connecting finger reduce *surroundingspaces* and *finger* in the Finger Joint Settings.
The lids needs to be glued. For the bayonet lid all outside rings attach to the bottom, all inside rings to the top.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RegularBox --n 5 --radius_bottom 80 --radius_top 80 --h 100 --outside 1 --top none --bottom closed --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes RegularBox --radius_bottom --radius_top --reference
